breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that slope vanishes at both supports and at midspan (by symmetry). The generated specification correctly removes this erroneous claim entirely. It only states the correct boundary conditions (zero deflection at both supports) and asks to compute the slope at the supports, which aligns with the ground truth prompt. The false assertion that slope is zero at the supports is not repeated.
